description: New England 30-bus Dynamic is a grid model dataset listed in Awesome Grid Model Data, a curated list of electricity grid model datasets under the section "MATPOWER (`.m`) > Dynamic Test Cases (UW Archive)", published or maintained by Dynamic Test Cases. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. It can support power-flow, dynamic-stability and production-cost model studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-grid-model-data.
